mapper.sql: SELECT dr.id, dr.serial_no, dr.batch_no, li.line_name, pt.type_name, dc.name AS category_name, dr.level, dr.result, dr.shift, dr.detect_time, dr.dispose_status, dr.dispose_remark FROM defect_record dr LEFT JOIN line_info li ON dr.line_id = li.id LEFT JOIN product_type pt ON dr.product_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN defect_category dc ON dr.category_id = dc.id WHERE dr.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM defect_record WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
AND dr.serial_no=#{serialNo} ORDER BY dr.detect_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defect_record WHERE DATE(detect_time)=#{date} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defect_record WHERE DATE(detect_time)=#{date} AND result=0 AND is_deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defect_record WHERE DATE(detect_time)=#{date} AND result=1 AND is_deleted=0
SELECT DATE(detect_time) AS date, ROUND(SUM(result)/COUNT(*),4) AS qualifiedRate FROM defect_record WHERE detect_time >= #{startDate} AND is_deleted=0 GROUP BY DATE(detect_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT li.line_name AS lineName, COUNT(*) AS defectCount FROM defect_record dr JOIN line_info li ON dr.line_id=li.id WHERE dr.is_deleted=0 AND dr.result=0 AND DATE(dr.detect_time)=#{date} GROUP BY li.id,li.line_name ORDER BY defectCount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defect_record WHERE batch_no=#{batchNo} AND is_deleted=0 AND line_id=#{lineId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defect_record WHERE batch_no=#{batchNo} AND result=1 AND is_deleted=0 AND line_id=#{lineId}

SELECT dc.name AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defect_record WHERE batch_no=#{batchNo} AND result=0 AND is_deleted=0),4) AS ratio FROM defect_record dr JOIN defect_category dc ON dr.category_id=dc.id WHERE dr.batch_no=#{batchNo} AND dr.result=0 AND dr.is_deleted=0 AND dr.line_id=#{lineId} GROUP BY dc.id,dc.name ORDER BY count DESC
